cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Ago Lite helps African shoppers find products, compare prices, and make buying decisions using voice and text in local languages. It works offline-first to save data costs.

test_prompts.prompt: Find me the cheapest 32 inch smart TV in Aba. Compare prices from Jumia and Konga.
